name: Rubber Expansion Joint
summary: Heavy-duty elastomeric rubber expansion joints designed to isolate pump vibration, absorb pipe movement, and compensate for misalignment in industrial water and fluid piping.
meta_description: Flexible rubber connectors for piping systems that absorb movement, isolate vibration, and compensate for thermal expansion or misalignment.
key_features: Outstanding vibration and sound attenuation for cooling water pumps, chillers, and compressors
High-tensile nylon cord and steel wire reinforcement prevents ballooning under surge pressure and vacuum conditions
Full-face rubber flange design creates a self-sealing joint, eliminating separate gasket requirements during installation
Elastomer tube options tailored for specific chemical resistance, oil compatibility, or potable water certification
Available with control rods (limit bolts) to prevent pipe over-extension and protect unanchored pump nozzles
applications: Main cooling water pumps and condenser lines in power plants and manufacturing facilities
Water and wastewater treatment plant piping (WTP & WWTP)
Palm oil mill effluent (POME) lines and raw water intake systems
Marine engine room sea chest cooling lines and bilge pumps
Industrial HVAC chilled water and condenser water circuits
materials: Inner Tube / Outer Cover: EPDM (water/steam), NBR (oil/fuel), Neoprene, Viton/FKM, Natural Rubber
Reinforcement: Nylon fabric cord, synthetic polyester yarn, spiral steel wire reinforcement rings
Retaining Flanges: Galvanized carbon steel, SS304, SS316
content_html:
Rubber Expansion Joint

Heavy-duty elastomeric rubber expansion joints designed to isolate pump vibration, absorb pipe movement, and compensate for axial, lateral, and angular misalignment in liquid piping systems. PT Misuba Guna Indonesia supplies single-arch, double-arch, and wide-arch rubber flexible joints molded with synthetic rubber tubes (EPDM, NBR/Nitrile, Neoprene, Natural Rubber, or Viton/FKM) and high-tensile fabric/wire reinforcement.

Featuring full-face integral rubber flanges with floating metal retaining rings, our rubber expansion joints eliminate metal-to-fluid contact and provide superior noise and shock suppression.

Custom Engineering Consultation & Ordering Guide

For immediate assistance with pump suction/discharge rubber joints, specify your line size (e.g. DN80 3-inch or DN200 8-inch), working fluid (e.g. seawater, cooling water, palm oil slurry, dilute acid), working pressure, and flange drilling (JIS 10K, ANSI 150#, DIN PN16). We stock standard sizes for quick dispatch across Indonesia.
